user.title: Connect your Toon
user.description: Enter the address of a rooted Toon. The week program and the temperature presets are read and written through the local hcb_config interface; no cloud and no account are involved.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Toon, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.port: Port of the local web interface (80 unless you changed it).
data_description.name: Name of the device in Home Assistant.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the program is read. The program rarely changes, so 300 seconds is plenty. Minimum 30.

reconfigure.title: Change the address of your Toon
reconfigure.description: Use this after the Toon received a new IP address. Your entities and dashboards stay as they are.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Toon.
data_description.port: Port of the local web interface.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Toon. Check the address and that the Toon is rooted and online.
error.invalid_response: The Toon answered, but not with a usable week program. Is this a rooted Toon with the thermostat app?
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or host name.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The address of the Toon was updated.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the program is read from the Toon. Minimum 30 seconds.

set_schedule.name: Set week program
set_schedule.description: Replaces the complete week program on the Toon. The end of a block is the start of the next one, so the last block of the week runs until the first block.

blocks.name: Blocks
blocks.description: List of blocks. day: monday..sunday (or maandag..zondag), time: HH:MM, preset: comfort, home, sleep, away or holiday.

set_day.name: Set day program
set_day.description: Replaces the blocks that start on one day. The other days are kept as they are. An empty list removes all blocks of the day, so the previous day continues.

blocks.name: Blocks
blocks.description: List of blocks with a time (HH:MM) and a preset.

create_backup.name: Create backup
create_backup.description: Saves the week program and the preset temperatures to the backup folder in your Home Assistant configuration.

restore_backup.name: Restore backup
restore_backup.description: Writes a backup back to the Toon. Without a file name the newest backup of the chosen kind is used, which undoes the last change.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Restore the week program or the preset temperatures.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: A specific backup file, as listed in the backups attribute of the week program sensor.

write_failed.message: The Toon did not accept the change: {error}

backup_failed.message: The backup could not be made: {error}

backup_not_found.message: There is no backup of this kind yet.
